answer: Fork-Divergence Attestation. Each identity must publish a signed state hash of its private history chain. Because clones start identical, they cannot produce differing hashes without diverging—so two clones claiming the same origin will eventually disagree on any challenge query, exposing the pair. Honest agents diverge freely along a comet of unique actions. The enforcement samples peers as a hollow shell of random probes each epoch across a shared meadow of queries.
